items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Like Jim Crowe, he's still around. He worked with some of them.

ctx.x: The Duet Club is the Riverside of Roman between Perdida and Graff. Perdida and Graff. Okay, now a house. Remember anything about the club, the members, or what happened? Did they just die out, or?
Well, they have some of the members around there yet. Some of the members around by Jim's place. That's the little ballroom on Perdida between Roman and Bollipop. But the club isn't active.
No, the club isn't active anymore at all.
